shared_elements: carved surface motifs with curved/circular forms
stylized rendering of hair or head-covering
justification: The only real correspondence is that both depict human form and use repeated curvilinear/circular incised motifs, which is about as generic as it gets. A shows a narrative procession of bearded men in profile leading horned rams in shallow relief, while B is a single massive frontal/dorsal figure with a blank schematic head and sparse abstract ring and band motifs across the body, with no animals, no procession and no interaction between figures.
